title: Singapore inflation: CPI and MAS Core, monthly since 1961
description: SingStat's Consumer Price Index for all items every month since 1961 and the year-on-year headline inflation rate, with MAS Core inflation (which leaves out accommodation and private transport) from 1991.
question: What is Singapore's inflation rate, headline and MAS Core, every month since 1961?

fields.name: month
fields.meaning: The month the prices are for.

fields.name: cpi_all_items
fields.meaning: SingStat's Consumer Price Index for all items.

fields.name: headline_inflation_pct_yoy
fields.unit: percent, against the same month a year before
fields.meaning: Headline inflation: how much the CPI rose over the year; blank for 1961, which has no year before.

fields.name: mas_core_index
fields.meaning: SingStat's MAS Core index, which leaves out accommodation and private transport; from 1990.

fields.name: mas_core_inflation_pct_yoy
fields.unit: percent, against the same month a year before
fields.meaning: MAS Core inflation: how much the MAS Core index rose over the year; from 1991.
